7 Brew 7 Fizz Soda: Price, Calories & Caffeine

A medium 7 Fizz Soda is about $3.50, with 0 calories, 0 mg of caffeine and 0 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

7 Fizz Soda allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists no declared allergens for the standard 7 Fizz Soda. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a 7 Fizz Soda

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium 7 Fizz Soda?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a 7 Fizz at Home

This is the easiest drink on the menu to copy, because there is nothing to brew, blend or heat. If you can make an Italian soda, you can make a fizz.

For one medium fizz

  • About 1 oz syrup total (one flavor, or split between two)
  • 10 to 12 oz sparkling water, the plainer the better
  • A full cup of ice
  • Optional: a splash of cream or a spoon of cold foam
  1. Syrup over the ice first.
  2. Pour the sparkling water in slowly so it keeps its bite.
  3. Stir once, gently. If you added cream, watch it marble for a second. That part is free entertainment.

Start with the classic: half an ounce each of blue raspberry and coconut makes the Ocean Breeze fizz, the one fans in the threads keep ordering with cream. Sugar-free: sugar-free syrup and plain sparkling water is a true 0-calorie drink, no asterisk.

7 Brew 7 Fizz Soda FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew 7 Fizz Soda?

A medium iced 7 Fizz Soda has 0 calories. A small has 0 and a large 0, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew 7 Fizz Soda?

0 mg in every size. The whole fizz line is caffeine free.

How much does a 7 Brew 7 Fizz Soda cost?

Roughly $2.75 for a small, $3.50 for a medium and $4.25 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew 7 Fizz Soda?

0 g in a medium.

What is a 7 Fizz, actually?

Sparkling water and flavored syrup over ice. That is the whole build, which makes it an Italian soda, the same family as the ones coffee shops have sold for decades. It is not a canned soda, not lemonade and definitely not an energy drink. 7 Brew calls it a handcrafted, caffeine-free soda with your choice of flavor, and the choice part is real: any syrup combo on the board can go in it. Fans online swear the sparkling water is one famous brand in particular. 7 Brew does not say, and it does not change the drink either way.

Does 7 Fizz have caffeine?

No. Zero, in every size and every flavor in the official guide. The fizz line is the caffeine-free side of the menu, full stop. The confusion comes from the names: most fizz flavors also exist as 7 Energy drinks, and the energy versions carry the caffeine. Same combo, different base. If the cup says Fizz, there is no caffeine in it unless somebody added a shot on purpose.

If a plain Fizz is 0 calories, why do flavored ones have 250?

Because the syrup is the calories. Plain sparkling water over ice is 0 calories and 0 g of sugar, and so are the two published sugar-free flavors. Add regular syrup and a medium lands at 240 calories for a Pink Mermaid, 250 for Blood Orange, Brew Lagoon or Sunrise, and 270 for Peaches 'n Cream, with 61 to 69 g of sugar. Still lighter than most of the menu, but not the free pass the plain number suggests.

What is the difference between 7 Fizz and 7 Energy?

The base, and everything follows from it. A fizz is sparkling water: no caffeine, lighter, crisper, and cheaper at about $3.50 for a medium. A 7 Energy is an energy drink: 105 mg of caffeine in a medium and about $5.25. The flavor combos are largely the same list on both sides of the menu, so the real question is whether you want the lift or just the flavor.

What is the best 7 Fizz flavor?

Fans keep landing on the same few. In the biggest fizz thread on Reddit, Pink Mermaid is the only flavor named as a favorite twice, and adding cream is the upgrade that comes up again and again, on Ocean Breeze, Blood Orange and half the others. Tasting Table tried 13 fizzes and put Pixie Stick first. Start with Pink Mermaid with cream if you want the crowd's answer, or work through the named flavors on our fizz drinks page.
